digest.component_or_area: reconciler outbound differ and backend mapper seam
propositions: outbound_differ compares in vendor shape while inbound_differ compares in canonical shape, creating asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) seam principle
outbound differ must canonicalize the remote snapshot via injected InboundMapper before field comparison, mirroring inbound differ's pattern
vendor-shaped update payloads must be emitted at the boundary via new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote, never built by core from vendor field names
InboundMapper output must include three new canonical alias keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) to support neutral comparison helpers in core
outbound differ's baseline arbitration path must apply inbound_mapper.map_remote_to_local to stored vendor-shaped baseline entries at read time, tolerating partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets
assignee resolver must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving accountId fast-path and non-authoritative fallback semantics
